LEAN_LIKE.note: Every pair is a transposition, so the canonical token multiset is identical by construction. Scalar features are judged by consistent sign. Multiset features are reported but never counted as leakage on their own: a bag has no direction, so a difference in it is not usable as an answer. What can be exploited is an asymmetry attached to the options, which the answer-targeted controls measure directly as accuracy against chance.
